title: Bulls vs Hornets — Zach LaVine assist request reviewed and NOT granted; league states postgame assist policy (Feb 9, 2022)
incident_summary: In the Feb 9, 2022 Bulls-Hornets game, Zach LaVine made what appeared to be a routine assist (a chest pass to DeMar DeRozan) but was not credited with the assist. Bettors holding over-5.5-assists LaVine wagers hoped for a stat correction that never came. In response to a fan inquiry, an NBA representative wrote that assists are credited at the discretion of the arena's in-game statisticians and that NBA Operations does not credit or remove assists postgame — only assists credited to the wrong player are updated. This negative case is kept to document the boundary of the correction pipeline: judgment-call assists are final as scored in-arena.
scoring_play: LaVine chest pass to DeRozan — assist was not credited (judgment call by in-arena statisticians).

originally_reported.value: No assist credited to LaVine on the play

corrected_value.basis: No correction issued — the league declined to add the assist.

final_official.basis: League policy response; no postgame change (ESPN).

sources_disagreed: Bettors/fans (assist should have been credited) vs. in-arena statisticians + NBA Operations (judgment stands; policy bars postgame assist creation)

cause.detail: No error was found or acknowledged. The non-credit reflects the in-arena statisticians' real-time judgment, which the league treats as final for assists except wrong-player attribution.

timeline.event: Bulls-Hornets; LaVine not credited with an assist on the DeRozan pass. LaVine assists over/under was 5.5 at sportsbooks.
NBA representative emails the assist-credit policy in reply to a fan: in-arena discretion; no postgame crediting/removal; only wrong-player assists updated.

sources.confirms: LaVine chest pass to DeRozan not credited; 5.5 assists line; correction hoped-for but never came; full NBA email policy quote; Elias 'far fewer corrections' rarity context.
